scenes.text: LOGGED AT TEN. LOST AT SIX.
scenes.narration: My reading glasses were handed in at ten this morning. I lost them on the bus at six tonight.
scenes.imagePrompt: A pair of folded reading glasses on the empty back seat of a night bus, the window beside them dark and streaked, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: I keep the lost property log for this building. The entry is in my handwriting. Glasses, tortoiseshell. Handed in, ten in the morning.
scenes.imagePrompt: A heavy ledger open on a desk, columns of faded handwritten entries too small to read, a fountain pen lying across the page, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: I WAS WEARING THEM AT TEN
scenes.narration: At ten this morning I was wearing them. I was reading that same log through them.
scenes.imagePrompt: A person in a grey cardigan bent over a ledger at a desk under a lamp, seen from behind over the shoulder, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: They are on the shelf now with a tag on them. I have not taken them back. I want to see who comes.
scenes.imagePrompt: A pair of reading glasses on a steel shelf in a wire mesh cage, a brown luggage tag tied to one arm on string, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain
